label: TP
reason: User-controlled input flows directly to file system via concatenation with TESTFILES_DIR without proper sanitization. Base64 encode/decode round-trip preserves original bytes including path traversal sequences like '..'. HTML encoding occurs only during display phase, after file system access has already happened, leaving path traversal exploitability intact.

evidence.note: User input retrieved via getParameter(), passed through Base64 round-trip (no effective sanitization), concatenated with TESTFILES_DIR prefix, then used to construct File object for filesystem access
